nodes.label: desktop memory - the v3 arm model stack

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Decided 2026-06-22 for the v3 canon eval harness, with the model choices split by ROLE rather than one checkpoint for everything. The shared generator and RAGAS judge are one model, qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b on NVIDIA NIM, current choice with nothing frozen - one generator injected by the orchestrator so the ONLY variable across arms is retrieval, and the same model as the RAGAS LLM-judge, multilingual so HERB now and the deferred Swedish Bonnier set later run on the same model with no swap. The vector-arm embedder is nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 on NIM: multilingual, English-strong, 8192-token context, embedding one document per artifact to mirror the lucene unit, with the 8192 context covering every HERB artifact whole so there is NO truncation and NO chunking, and exact brute-force cosine because the roughly 38.6k-artifact corpus is too small to need an ANN index - a deliberate capable multilingual dense baseline, not the English-only 256-token all-MiniLM textbook naive-RAG default, which is REJECTED. The lucene arm is bm25s method='lucene', the Lucene and Elasticsearch BM25 variant and bm25s's default, with k1=0.9 and b=0.4 as BEIR reference defaults. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.1 verdict: CONTRADICTS-USER in method - the file contains a section headed 'Why this overrides the earlier ground references the user pasted', an agent documenting in writing that it overrode source material he handed it; the technical call may be right, but the standing rule is to surface a genuine conflict as a question, not a correction, and this is the correction recorded as settled. 6.3 also flags its 'Scoring is HERB + RAGAS only' as the superseded position preserved with equal authority
